purpose: Make callisto's changelog and PR-body rendering accurately reflect every real cause of a version bump, by (1) making crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/pr_body.rs prioritize callisto_changelog::render_section and the already-built ChangelogInput data in VersionPlan.changelog_writes over its own hand-rolled per-BumpReason Markdown (retained as a fallback, not deleted) whenever a matching ChangelogWrite exists, and (2) wiring three confirmed pieces of real, already-computed cause data -- InferenceOutcome.commits, GroupCheckOutcome.new_members, and a package's non-changeset outcome.reasons entry that co-occurs with a changeset entry -- through to ChangelogInput.entries instead of letting them be silently discarded.
scope: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/pr_body.rs (Release Reason collapsible-details rendering only, not the Executive Summary table); crates/callisto-graph/src/aggregate.rs (BumpReason::Inference construction site, ~lines 223-236); crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs (the changelog_inputs if/else at ~lines 148-215, and group_check consumption at ~line 219); crates/callisto-changelog/src/input.rs is read but not modified (ChangeSource variants already exist and are sufficient). No change to callisto_changelog::render_section, callisto-changelog/src/write.rs, or inference's own severity computation.
non_goals: A full multi-cause union covering more than one non-changeset reason per package in the same run (e.g. two independent cascades, or a cascade plus a peer-escalation, both non-changeset, for the same package). outcome.reasons and agg.reasons are BTreeMap<PackageId, BumpReason> (single-valued), not BTreeMap<PackageId, Vec<BumpReason>>, all the way through cascade.rs's severity/reason bookkeeping. This spec's scope is exactly changeset-plus-one-other-reason (AC-005); a full N-reason union requires changing that data model throughout cascade.rs and is a separate, larger track. ChangeSource::NewGroupMember (AC-004) is independent of this limitation -- it is always additive on top of whatever AC-005/AC-006 already produced for the package, never subject to the single-valued outcome.reasons constraint, since new_members is tracked in a separate structure (GroupCheckOutcome).

Any change to callisto_changelog::render_section's rendering logic, grouping, section ordering, or Markdown output format -- it is already implemented and correct; this track only changes what calls it and what ChangelogInput data it is fed.
Any change to how CHANGELOG.md is written to disk (crates/callisto-changelog/src/write.rs) -- untouched.
Any change to inference's own severity-computation logic, or to when inference fires at all -- only what data survives from InferenceOutcome to the resulting ChangeSource is in scope.

The exact Rust data-modeling mechanism used to carry a representative (CommitSha, String) pair from InferenceOutcome through to ChangeSource::Commit (e.g. a new field on BumpReason::Inference vs. a side-channel map in AggregateOutcome) is left to the implementer -- this spec constrains only the observable output (which commit's sha/subject appears in the rendered changelog entry), not the internal storage shape.

pr_body.rs's Executive Summary table (### Release Summary, the `| Package | Ecosystem | ... | Reason |` table built at pr_body.rs:82-136) is unchanged by this track, INCLUDING its own existing match arms on BumpReason::Cascade/PeerEscalation/FixedGroupUnion/LinkedGroupUnion at lines 99-124 -- these are one-line table-cell labels, not rendered changelog sections, and remain in the file untouched after this track. render_section has no one-line output mode -- consolidating that table is out of scope; only the collapsible '#### Release Reason' block inside each package's `<details>` (pr_body.rs:175-218) changes, and only in its dispatch logic (see AC-001/AC-002), not by deleting the existing per-BumpReason match.

Constructing BumpReason::NewGroupMember (or any new BumpReason variant) is not required by this spec -- the NewGroupMember gap can be closed by directly constructing ChangeSource::NewGroupMember in version.rs's changelog-entry synthesis without necessarily threading a corresponding BumpReason through outcome.reasons; the implementer may choose either path as long as AC-004's observable behavior holds.

Introducing any new public or private function beyond what's needed to add the render_section-priority dispatch and call render_section instead of the fallback when applicable -- AC-007's test method calls the existing public render_pr_body_from_plan function; no new 'per-package rendering' function is introduced by this spec.

The pre-existing per-BumpReason match in pr_body.rs (lines 178-216, covering Changeset/Cascade/PeerEscalation/FixedGroupUnion/LinkedGroupUnion, extended by this spec to also cover Inference/PreRelease/NewGroupMember per AC-002) is explicitly RETAINED in the file, not deleted -- it becomes the fallback path used when no matching ChangelogWrite exists (AC-002) or when render_section errors on an existing ChangelogWrite (AC-007), rather than the sole rendering path it is today.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: For every bump in VersionPlan.bumps whose package has a matching entry `w` in VersionPlan.changelog_writes (i.e. some `w` where `w.input.package == bump.package`) AND `render_section(&w.input)` returns `Ok(section)`, the '#### Release Reason' block inside that package's `<details>` element in ComposePrBodyReport.body contains, verbatim, `section` -- and does NOT contain the per-BumpReason fallback text AC-002 describes, even when the bump's `reason` field is also `Some(..)` and would independently produce non-empty fallback text. render_section's output takes dispatch priority over the fallback match whenever both are available for the same package; the fallback match (retained per non_goals, not deleted) is reached only under the conditions AC-002 and AC-007 describe. Test method: a new unit test in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/pr_body.rs's `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` constructs a VersionPlan with one PlannedBump whose `reason` is `Some(BumpReason::Cascade{ via, dep_kind, spec, dependency_to })` (so the fallback match's Cascade arm, if reached, would produce text containing the literal fragment "Automatic dependency cascade triggered by") AND a matching ChangelogWrite (built the same way version.rs builds it, with a real ChangeSource::Changeset entry, independent of the bump's `reason`), calls `render_pr_body_from_plan`, independently calls `callisto_changelog::render_section` on the same ChangelogInput in the test body to compute `expected_section`, and asserts `report.body.contains(&expected_section)` AND `!report.body.contains("Automatic dependency cascade triggered by")` -- proving render_section's output was used and the fallback text was not, despite both being reachable inputs for the same package.

For a bump whose package has no entry in VersionPlan.changelog_writes (the package declares no changelog file, i.e. `pkg.changelog` is `None` in the versioning pipeline, so version.rs's changelog-write loop at ~lines 148-215 never runs for it), that package's `<details>` block in ComposePrBodyReport.body still contains a non-empty '#### Release Reason' section, for every BumpReason variant, using the retained per-BumpReason fallback match (pr_body.rs:178-216) -- render_pr_body_from_plan does not error, panic, or emit an empty '#### Release Reason' heading with no following text for such a package. This explicitly includes BumpReason::Inference, BumpReason::PreRelease, and BumpReason::NewGroupMember, which the fallback match does NOT currently handle (they fall to the `_ => {}` catch-all at line 216 today, rendering an empty heading with no content) -- confirmed live as an existing gap that this track's own AC-003/AC-004 additions make newly reachable in practice (packages bumped via Inference or newly joining a group can now have a no-changelog-file case). This track must add fallback text for these three variants inside the same match, e.g.: `BumpReason::Inference { commits, .. } => format!("- Inferred from {} commit(s) since the last release.

", commits)`, `BumpReason::PreRelease { tag } => format!("- Pre-release finalization (tag `{}`).

", tag)`, `BumpReason::NewGroupMember { group } => format!("- New member of group `{}`.

", group.as_str())` (exact wording is the implementer's choice; the requirement is non-empty, non-panicking content). Test method: unit tests in pr_body.rs constructing a VersionPlan with one PlannedBump and an empty `changelog_writes` Vec (simulating no changelog file for that package), once each for `reason: Some(BumpReason::Cascade{..})` (pre-existing coverage), `Some(BumpReason::Inference{..})`, `Some(BumpReason::PreRelease{..})`, and `Some(BumpReason::NewGroupMember{..})` -- asserting for each that `render_pr_body_from_plan` returns `Ok` and `report.body` contains '#### Release Reason' followed by non-whitespace content before the next `</details>`.

When a package's bump in a `plan_version` run has `pkg.changelog` equal to `Some(..)`, is driven by `BumpReason::Inference` (i.e. `outcome.reasons.get(id) == Some(BumpReason::Inference{..})`), AND `agg.changelog_inputs.get(id)` is `None` (no pending changeset for this package -- the changeset-present case is covered by AC-005, not here, since {changelog_inputs: Some, reason: Inference} is a reachable state where a changeset and an inference-driven reason coexist): if the `InferenceOutcome` returned by the `SeverityInference` implementation for that package has a non-empty `commits: Vec<(CommitSha, String)>`, the `ChangelogInput.entries` for that package in the resulting `VersionPlan.changelog_writes` contains exactly one entry before AC-004's independent NewGroupMember append (if applicable) -- a `ChangelogEntry` whose `source` is `ChangeSource::Commit { sha, subject }` with `sha` and `subject` equal to `commits[0]`'s `CommitSha` and `String` respectively (`commits[0]` because `callisto-vcs`'s `commits_since` shells `git log --no-merges` without a reversing flag -- git's default newest-first order -- so index 0 is the most recent commit; this choice is documented with a code comment at the construction site), AND whose `severity` field equals the package's resolved bump severity for this run (`outcome.severities.get(id)`, i.e. the same severity value used to construct the corresponding `PlannedBump`). If instead `commits` is empty (a state `InferenceOutcome`'s type does not itself prevent, even though `commit_count` is nonzero), `ChangelogInput.entries` for that package contains exactly one entry before AC-004's independent NewGroupMember append (if applicable) -- a `ChangelogEntry` with `source` matching `ChangeSource::Changeset { filename: String::new(), summary: format!("Inferred version bump ({} commit(s))", commit_count) }` and `severity` equal to the resolved bump severity -- mirroring AC-006's fallback pattern rather than leaving this state unhandled. Test method: two integration tests in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs's test module. (1) supplies a fake `SeverityInference` impl whose `infer()` returns `Ok(Some(InferenceOutcome { severity: Severity::Minor, commit_count: 2, remapped: false, commits: vec![(sha_recent, "feat: recent".into()), (sha_older, "fix: older".into())] }))` for a fixture package with `pkg.changelog` set, no pending changeset, and NOT a member of any fixed or linked group (so AC-004 does not independently apply and entries.len() == 1 is the correct total), calls `plan_version`, and asserts the resulting `ChangelogInput.entries` for that package has `entries.len() == 1` with `source` matching `ChangeSource::Commit { sha: sha_recent, subject: "feat: recent".to_string() }` (not `sha_older`) and `severity == Severity::Minor`. (2) same fixture (including not being a fixed/linked group member) but `InferenceOutcome { commit_count: 2, commits: vec![], .. }` (empty commits, nonzero count), asserting `entries.len() == 1` with the entry matching `ChangeSource::Changeset { filename: "", summary }` where `summary == "Inferred version bump (2 commit(s))"`.

When a package ID appears in `GroupCheckOutcome.new_members`'s `Vec<PackageId>` for some `GroupName` key (computed by `pre_mutation_checks` at crates/callisto-graph/src/groups.rs:85, exposed to `plan_version` as `group_check.new_members` at crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs:87-94) AND that package has a bump this run (i.e. `outcome.severities.get(id)` is `Some(sev)` with `sev != Severity::None`) AND `pkg.changelog` is `Some(..)`, the `ChangelogInput.entries` for that package in `VersionPlan.changelog_writes` contains, as its LAST entry (appended after any entries AC-003/AC-005/AC-006 already contributed for the same package -- this criterion is always additive, never a replacement, since GroupCheckOutcome.new_members is a separate structure from the single-valued outcome.reasons map and is not subject to AC-005's non_goals limitation), a `ChangelogEntry` whose `source` is `ChangeSource::NewGroupMember { group }` with `group` equal to that `GroupName` key, AND whose `severity` field equals the package's resolved bump severity for this run (`outcome.severities.get(id)`, i.e. the same severity value used for the package's `PlannedBump`). Test method: two integration tests in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs's test module. (1) constructs a fixture workspace with a fixed group containing one already-released member and one fresh (never-tagged) member, BOTH starting at the identical manifest base version (e.g. both 1.0.0, only the released member carrying a git tag) so the fixed-group convergence block's winner already equals the fresh member's own target and cascade.rs:433-440 never overwrites its reason, with `pkg.changelog` set on the fresh member, drives a bump for the fresh member via a changeset with no other reason for the same package this run (so `outcome.reasons.get(id)` is `None` or a Changeset-derived reason with no AC-005 mapping, and AC-005 does not independently contribute a second entry), calls `plan_version`, and asserts `entries.len() == 2`: the changeset entry first (arriving via the pre-existing `agg.changelog_inputs` branch at version.rs:149, NOT via AC-005, since AC-005 requires a genuine non-changeset `outcome.reasons` value which this fixture does not have), and the `ChangeSource::NewGroupMember` entry last. (2) same fixture (both members still at the identical starting manifest base version, so cascade.rs:433-440's overwrite is still never taken), but the fresh member is ALSO a cascade target this run with a cascade-driven severity strictly greater than the seeded severity (satisfying cascade.rs:501's `sev > cur_sev` gate so the cascade path actually fires and `outcome.reasons.get(id)` becomes `Some(BumpReason::Cascade{..})`, which -- because both members share the same manifest base version -- the fixed-group convergence step at cascade.rs:433-440 does not overwrite back to FixedGroupUnion), exercising AC-005's additive entry too; asserts `entries.len() == 3` in order: `ChangeSource::Changeset{..}`, `ChangeSource::DependencyUpdate{..}` (AC-005's Cascade mapping), `ChangeSource::NewGroupMember{..}` (this criterion, appended last).

When a package `id` with a bump this run has BOTH a changeset-sourced entry (`agg.changelog_inputs.get(id)` is `Some`) AND a genuine non-changeset reason recorded for the same run (`outcome.reasons.get(id)` is `Some(reason)` where `reason` is one of `Cascade`, `PeerEscalation`, `FixedGroupUnion`, `LinkedGroupUnion`, or `Inference` -- the first four are the variants version.rs's synthesis branch already maps to a `ChangeSource` at ~lines 158-187; `Inference` maps per AC-003's own Commit-or-empty-commits-fallback logic, reused here rather than duplicated), the resulting `ChangelogInput.entries` for that package contains, as its first N entries (N = the changeset-sourced entry count): every entry from `agg.changelog_inputs.get(id)`'s `entries`, verbatim and in original order, immediately followed by exactly one additional `ChangelogEntry` whose `source` is the `ChangeSource` variant that mapping produces for `reason` (AC-003's mapping when `reason` is `Inference`, version.rs's existing mapping otherwise), with `severity` equal to the package's resolved bump `severity` for this run. This criterion describes ONLY these N+1 entries; it does not claim `entries.len()` in total, since AC-004's NewGroupMember entry (when also applicable to the same package) is independently appended afterward per AC-004's own ordering rule. Test method: two integration tests in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs's test module. (1) constructs a fixture where a package has one pending changeset AND is also a cascade target this run with cascade severity strictly greater than the changeset's severity (satisfying cascade.rs:501's `sev > cur_sev` gate), and is NOT a new group member, calls `plan_version`, and asserts `changelog_writes` for that package has `entries.len() == 2`, with the first entry's `source` matching `ChangeSource::Changeset{..}` and the second matching `ChangeSource::DependencyUpdate{..}` (the mapping for `BumpReason::Cascade`). (2) same shape but the package's `outcome.reasons.get(id)` is `Some(BumpReason::Inference{..})` instead of Cascade (a real inference-then-changeset-both-present state), asserts `entries.len() == 2` with the second entry matching AC-003's Commit-or-fallback mapping for that Inference reason.

When a package has a bump this run (severity > None), `pkg.changelog` is `Some`, `agg.changelog_inputs.get(id)` is `None` (no changeset), AND `outcome.reasons.get(id)` is either `None` or a variant with no direct `ChangeSource` mapping under AC-003/AC-005 (falls to the catch-all currently at version.rs:188-199), `plan_version` does not panic and does not return `Err` attributable to this condition -- `VersionPlan.changelog_writes` contains exactly one `ChangelogWrite` for that package whose `input.entries.len() >= 1` before AC-004's independent NewGroupMember append (if applicable), preserving the existing fallback: a single `ChangeSource::Changeset { filename: String::new(), summary: format!("Version bump ({})", <severity as major|minor|patch|none>) }` entry. Test method: integration test in version.rs's test module. Because a bump with `reason: None` is unreachable through plan_version (every severity insertion on that path pairs with a reason insertion -- inference, changeset, fixed/linked union, PreRelease-mode exit, and cascade raise/sibling-leveling all insert both together, and nothing removes from `reasons`), this criterion is tested via the reachable no-mapping variant: construct a fixture workspace containing `.changeset/pre.json` with `mode: "exit"` and a tag, one package whose canonical manifest version is a pre-release (e.g. `1.1.0-alpha.1`) with `pkg.changelog` set, no pending changeset files on disk, not a member of any fixed or linked group, and pass `crate::infer::NoInference` as the SeverityInference impl so no Inference reason is recorded. version.rs's PreRelease-exit handling then injects `Severity::Patch` and `BumpReason::PreRelease { tag }`, `agg.changelog_inputs.get(id)` is `None`, and the catch-all at version.rs:188-199 is reached (PreRelease has no direct ChangeSource mapping under AC-003/AC-005). Call `plan_version` with `VersionOptions::default()`, assert it returns `Ok`, and assert the package's `ChangelogWrite.input.entries` has exactly 1 entry matching `ChangeSource::Changeset { filename: "", summary }` where `summary == "Version bump (patch)"`.

render_pr_body_from_plan's call to `callisto_changelog::render_section(&w.input)` for a given package's matching ChangelogWrite `w`, when that call returns any `Err(..)` (including but not limited to `ChangelogError::EmptyInput` when `w.input.entries` is empty, or `ChangelogError::SeverityNoneEntry` when an entry's severity is `Severity::None`), never causes the overall render_pr_body_from_plan call to panic or return `Err` because of that one package's rendering failure -- that package's `<details>` block still renders using the AC-002 fallback path, and every other package's block in the same PR body renders normally and completely. Two fallback sub-cases within that fallback path: (a) when the package's `bump.reason` is `Some(..)`, the block uses AC-002's per-BumpReason text; (b) when `bump.reason` is `None` (no reason available either), the block falls back to the literal line `_No changelog entries available._`. Note: this scenario is confirmed unreachable through the normal `plan_version` -> `pr_body` pipeline as of AC-003/AC-005/AC-006 (changelog_writes entries are never empty and never carry a Severity::None entry when reached via plan_version), so this criterion is tested by calling the existing public function `render_pr_body_from_plan` (no new function is introduced) with a hand-constructed `VersionPlan` whose matching ChangelogWrite is deliberately built to make render_section fail (bypassing plan_version entirely). Test method: three unit tests -- (1) `w.input.entries` is an empty Vec (triggers EmptyInput), `reason: Some(BumpReason::Cascade{..})`, plus a second, unaffected PlannedBump with normal data; asserts `render_pr_body_from_plan` returns `Ok` and the body contains both the AC-002 fallback text for the first package and the normally-rendered render_section output for the second. (2) `w.input.entries` contains one `ChangelogEntry` with `severity: Severity::None` (triggers SeverityNoneEntry), `reason: Some(BumpReason::Cascade{..})`; asserts `Ok` and the AC-002 fallback text appears for that package. (3) `w.input.entries` is an empty Vec, `reason: None`; asserts `Ok` and the body contains the literal line `_No changelog entries available._` inside that package's `<details>` block.
